name: gpt-5-6-router
description: Opt-in API classification selects a user-allowlisted Codex model and effort. Legacy deterministic routing remains available.

interface.shortDescription: Configurable AI routing with native Codex delegation
interface.longDescription: v0.3.0 offers opt-in OpenAI API classification with separately billed API credits, exact user-approved model/effort pairs, direct execution for an exact root match, and at most one native-validated child for a different selection. Codex permissions and model restrictions still apply. Legacy deterministic GPT-6 Luna or Sol routing, with a gated Astra tier, remains available when configured AI routing is not enabled. Limited macOS CLI execution is demonstrated; Desktop credential inheritance, other environments, workload quality and cost savings are not established.
defaultPrompt: Show the current routing configuration without making model calls.
Explain the API billing and hook permissions before setup.
Route this task using only my configured model and effort allowlist.
